s1.ptxt: Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
Disconnect vacuum hose (1) from brake booster.
Connect special tool to vacuum hose.
Check negative pressure with engine idling. If negative pressure is not as specified, replace vacuum pump.

spec.title: Negative pressure specification at idle speed
spec.ptxt: –50 kPa (–0.5 kgf/cm2, –7.25 psi, –0.5 bar) within 7 seconds
–85 kPa (–0.9 kgf/cm2, –12.3 psi, –0.85 bar) within 28 seconds

s1.ptxt: Disconnect special tool and connect brake vacuum pump hose to brake booster.
